meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 给已有的口播、访谈或播客视频叠加按时间同步的设计图形卡片——标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用、侧栏、画中画等，画幅可选 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5，原片画面全程不动，最后渲染成 MP4。
howto.when: 当你提到「graphic overlays」「on-screen graphics」等关键词，或要求包装整条视频时触发；纯字幕不用这个技能，意图不清先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这段访谈加上数据标注和标题卡片，画幅用 9:16
say.note: 先转录，再设计卡片，最后渲染成 MP4

say.text: 把这个播客片段包装一下，加下三分之一和引用卡片
say.note: 原片画面保持不动，卡片叠在上面

say.text: 用 16:9 重新包装我的口播视频，加一个画中画侧栏
say.note: 卡片时间轴对齐转录文本

howto.what_en: Adds timed, designed graphic cards — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP — onto a talking-head, interview, or podcast clip, synced to its transcript. Canvas: 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5; clip plays untouched; output MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or "package / dress up my video". Plain subtitles are not this skill; unclear intent routes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Add data callouts and title cards to this interview, in 9:16
say_en.note: Transcribes first, designs cards, then renders MP4

say_en.text: Package this podcast clip with lower-thirds and quote cards
say_en.note: Clip stays untouched under the overlays

say_en.text: Recut my talking-head video in 16:9 with a PiP side panel
say_en.note: Cards are timed to the transcript
